subject: Equity allocation calendar for Q3 hiring
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: People Ops <people-ops@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Equity allocation calendar for Q3 hiring

Hi team,

We have a tight hiring cadence for July/August and need to lock equity allocations so offers don't hit a stale 409A price window. Key facts up front:
- Board packet deadline: 2025-07-28 (board meeting 2025-08-04)
- Current 409A valuation expires: 2025-08-10 for purposes of new option grants
- Hiring targets: 6 ICs and 1 manager in Product for late July/early Aug start

Ask: can Finance + Legal confirm whether we can batch-option grants for the July board (i.e., approve new option grants at the 8/4 meeting) or if we should push offers with interim equity holds? If we miss the board, the next likely approval window is mid-September which will push offer timelines and create compensation mismatches.

I've attached the candidate-offer-matrix and a draft timeline to this email. My suggested path:
1) Move two senior IC offers to conditional equity pending board approval, provide short-term RSU top-ups if candidate requires immediacy.
2) Reserve 1.2% of the option pool for this hiring tranche in the July packet.
3) Coordinate with People Ops on communication scripts for candidates where equity is pending.

Please review the matrix and flag any blockers by EOD Friday so I can finalize the board slides.

Thanks,
Monica

--
Monica Patel
Head of Talent Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: candidate-offer-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet), q3-equity-timeline-slides.pdf (draft slides)

Monica — thanks for the clear summary. A couple quick notes from recruiting ops perspective:

- Candidates A and B (senior ICs) expect a written offer by next Tuesday (7/22). They are considering other opportunities and equity clarity is a gating item for both.
- Manager role can wait two weeks if needed but we should avoid giving cash-only sweeteners unless absolutely necessary.

We should avoid stretching a long "pending board" message; candidates respond better to a concrete note that equity is subject to board approval with a clear timeline. If Finance confirms we can sign offers with a conditional grant, I will use that language.

I can coordinate candidate comms drafts after Finance/Legal weigh in.

— Vivek

Quick legal check-in: we can issue offers that state equity grants are "subject to board approval and final 409A pricing." Two practical points:
1) If the 409A reprice occurs before the board meeting (unlikely but possible), we need a fallback: either honor the grant at the time of offer filing or at the board-approved price — Finance needs to confirm which we will commit to.
2) For candidates who require immediate vesting protections, we can include a short-term cash retention or a one-time sign-on bonus that is independent of equity.

I'll ask Legal to draft a short clause for the offer letter we can reuse. Laura, can you confirm current pool runway if we reserve 1.2% now?

Thanks,
Karthik

Subject: Re: Equity allocation calendar for Q3 hiring

All — I pulled the numbers. If we reserve 1.2% for the July packet we will have ~0.9% left for the remainder of Q3 under current hiring plans, which is tight but workable assuming a couple of planned offers slide into Q4. Finance preference is to get explicit board approval for the grants at the 8/4 meeting so we have clean accounting and avoid ad-hoc grants under delegation.

Regarding the 409A timing: our valuation team expects the current 409A to remain defensible through 2025-08-10, but market comps are shifting and there is a small chance we need an interim valuation if we see a material change. If that happens, we will need Legal to confirm whether we honor the earlier price or reprice.

I'll attach the deck I'll include in the August packet. Monica, please confirm final list of candidates and exact requested allocation by Monday 7/21.

Laura
CFO (interim)
Redwood Inference

Quick update to close the loop — I spoke with Kate (Greenline) this afternoon. They are OK with a conditional grant structure as long as we:
- Provide a clear timeline tying grant to the 8/4 board approval;
- Include a clause that preserves grant quantity subject to board approval (i.e., no retroactive reduction); and
- Offer a modest interim sign-on bonus for Senior ICs if needed.

Ava HR has a drafted candidate script ready to go; copying them here for roll-out once Legal finalizes the clause. Monica: I pushed candidate offers for A and B to go out tomorrow 7/23 with the conditional equity language and a 2-week window for acceptance. Please attach the applicant-facing FAQ for equity staging.

I'll update the board packet with Laura's numbers and include Greenline's note as part of the investor context slide.

Thanks everyone — this feels like a pragmatic path forward.

— Vivek
